tasks.title: Симулятор: ограждение хоста oVirt
tasks.statement: Менеджер потерял связь с хостом и решает, что делать: мягко перезапустить VDSM по SSH, пропустить ограждение по политике кластера или выключить и включить сервер через управление питанием. В пяти ситуациях подберите настройки так, чтобы результат был правильным: не перезагружать живой сервер, не устраивать шторм перезагрузок и всё же перезапускать высокодоступные машины, когда хост точно мёртв. Упражнение решено, когда выполнены цели всех пяти ситуаций.
tasks.hint: Мягкое ограждение идёт первым. Политика «живая аренда» защищает рабочий хост, чьё управление сломано, а порог связи — кластер при отказе коммутатора: он должен быть выше доли одного упавшего хоста, но не выше доли упавших при аварии. Если контроллер питания мёртв, остаётся только аренда на стороне виртуальной машины.

scenarios.title: VDSM hung
scenarios.story: One host of four stopped answering because the vdsmd process hung. The server itself works, its VMs run, SSH answers.
scenarios.goal: Bring the host back to Up without a reboot
scenarios.hint: The cheapest step comes first: restart the service, not the whole server.

scenarios.title: The server died
scenarios.story: One host of four lost power. Its VMs are down, one of them is highly available. SSH does not answer, the controller works.
scenarios.goal: Switch the host off and on through power management and restart the highly available VM elsewhere
scenarios.hint: A VM may be started elsewhere only after the engine is sure the host is off. A threshold that is too low would also skip this case.

scenarios.title: Management network down
scenarios.story: The management network cable of one host is broken. The host is alive, its VMs work and write to storage over another network, SSH is unreachable.
scenarios.goal: Do not touch the host: fencing is skipped because of the live lease
scenarios.hint: A reboot of a working host would kill its VMs. The lease on storage proves the host is alive.

scenarios.title: The switch failed
scenarios.story: The management switch failed: the engine lost contact with 3 of 4 hosts. The hosts are alive, but the storage runs through the same switch, so leases cannot be read.
scenarios.goal: Skip fencing because of connectivity issues, without a storm of reboots
scenarios.hint: Three of four is 75%. The threshold must be low enough to skip this, but high enough not to skip one dead host out of four.

scenarios.title: The controller died too
scenarios.story: A host lost power together with its management controller: power management cannot reach it. A highly available VM was running on it.
scenarios.goal: Restart the highly available VM even though the host cannot be fenced
scenarios.hint: A VM with a lease on storage can be started elsewhere once the dead host stops renewing it.

tasks.title: Доска: отказы хостов и ограждение
tasks.statement: Вы собираете окружение, в котором упавший хост можно оградить: нужен агент ограждения на хосте и другой хост в состоянии Up того же дата-центра в роли прокси. Пять сценариев: единственный хост, которого некому ограждать; управление питанием на каждом хосте; прокси, который сам неисправен; другой дата-центр, который не считается; хосты, забытые в режиме обслуживания. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Ограждение проходит путь: менеджер, прокси, агент, хост. Пройдите его и посмотрите, какой шаг не проходит: нет агента или нет хоста Up в том же дата-центре.

scenarios.title: Nobody can fence the only host
scenarios.story: The data center has one host and it has power management. When it hangs, the engine cannot switch it off: the command has to be sent by another host.
scenarios.goal: Every host can be fenced and the data center survives the loss of any single host
scenarios.hint: The fence command is run by a proxy: another Up host of the same data center. Follow the path of the fence and see which hop fails; then remember that a new host needs its own agent.

scenarios.title: Power management on every host
scenarios.story: Only host-1 has power management. If host-2 or host-3 stops answering, the engine cannot switch it off, and its VM stays stuck.
scenarios.goal: Every host has a fence agent and can be fenced
scenarios.hint: Fencing needs two things: a fence agent on the host and another Up host as the proxy. Hosts and the proxy are fine here; select a host and check whether the fence path reaches its agent.

scenarios.title: The proxy must be Up
scenarios.story: Every host has power management, yet host-1 cannot be fenced. host-2 is NonOperational, host-3 is NonResponsive and web-2 on it is down.
scenarios.goal: All hosts are Up, both VMs run and every host can be fenced
scenarios.hint: The proxy has to be an Up host, so a host that is itself broken cannot help. Read the reason of each host: fix the one that the engine cannot reach first, then the next reason appears.

scenarios.title: The proxy stays in the data center
scenarios.story: The engine manages three hosts with power management, and two of them are in Default. The only host of the Remote data center cannot be fenced all the same.
scenarios.goal: Every host can be fenced and both data centers are Up
scenarios.hint: A proxy is always a host of the same data center as the host being fenced. The hosts of another data center do not count, however many there are.

scenarios.title: The upgrade round that did not end
scenarios.story: After the upgrade round host-2 and host-3 are still in maintenance. The board looks healthy, because they run nothing, but host-1 cannot be fenced.
scenarios.goal: All three hosts are Up and every host can be fenced
scenarios.hint: A host in maintenance is not Up, so it cannot serve as a proxy. Select the hosts and look at their parameters.

tasks.title: Доска: высокодоступные машины
tasks.statement: Вы настраиваете окружение так, чтобы высокодоступные машины возвращались после потери хоста: у хоста должен быть агент ограждения, а на хосте-цели в том же кластере должны быть сети, хранилище и память для машины. Пять сценариев: агент на каждом хосте с такой машиной; цель, на которой машина не запустится; память для нескольких перезапущенных машин; машины без отметки высокой доступности; запасной хост в другом кластере. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Мысленно потеряйте хост и пройдите по шагам: агент ограждения, прокси, затем первая подходящая цель в том же кластере. Цель должна быть в состоянии Up и вместить машину вместе с её сетями, дисками и памятью.

scenarios.title: HA without power management
scenarios.story: web-1 and db-1 are marked highly available and run on different hosts. Only host-1 has a fence agent, so if host-2 fails, db-1 will not be restarted.
scenarios.goal: Both HA VMs would restart after the loss of their host
scenarios.hint: The engine restarts an HA VM only after it knows its host is off, and that needs power management. Check every host that runs an HA VM; a host with no HA VM does not need an agent.

scenarios.title: A target that cannot run the VM
scenarios.story: web-1 is highly available and host-1 has power management. host-2 is NonOperational, and even when it comes Up, the VM could not start there.
scenarios.goal: Everything works and web-1 would restart on host-2 after the loss of host-1
scenarios.hint: A restart target has to be Up and has to offer everything the VM uses: its networks and its storage. Read the reason on host-2, then check the network of web-1 on it.

scenarios.title: Room for the restarted VMs
scenarios.story: host-1 runs web-1 and web-2, 16 GB each, both highly available. Everything is Up, but host-2 has 16 GB and a small VM of its own, so it cannot take them.
scenarios.goal: Both web VMs would restart after the loss of host-1 and everything keeps running
scenarios.hint: The restarted VMs share the memory of the target. Add up what is already on it and what comes; a host with more memory or another host will do.

scenarios.title: Only the marked VMs come back
scenarios.story: Three hosts have power management. When host-1 failed in a test, web-1 came back by itself, but web-2 did not. db-1 on host-2 would be left the same way.
scenarios.goal: web-2 and db-1 are highly available too, and all HA VMs would restart
scenarios.hint: A VM that is not marked highly available is only marked down when its host is fenced. Select the VM and look at its parameters.

scenarios.title: The spare host is in another cluster
scenarios.story: host-1 alone is in cluster-a, with two HA VMs. cluster-b has two hosts and room to spare, but the engine has nowhere to restart the VMs.
scenarios.goal: Both HA VMs would restart after the loss of host-1 and everything keeps running
scenarios.hint: An HA VM restarts only inside its own cluster. A host belongs to one cluster, so a host that is needed in cluster-a must first leave the other one.
